summary: Subtraction-first resolution of the TriggerLab god-object: commit fully to direction (a) of speculative-generality-0001 — make the R20-R24 extraction real by DELETING all 75 one-line forwarders and the 5 single-implementation *Host exported interfaces, publishing the five existing controllers as named seams (store.shows, store.sections, store.monitor, store.controllerTest, store.midi) and letting `pnpm typecheck` enumerate the exact repoint list. We explicitly REJECT the additive three-facade architecture proposed in divergent-change-0002 (its own interface_delta says 'increases'): once forwarders are gone, the change axes that finding measured (shows CRUD, sections, controller monitoring, MIDI) already land in controller files instead of store.svelte.ts — re-measure churn before adding any new layer. Every other step is a collapse: ShowLibrarySync+SongLibrarySync fold into one generic LibrarySync (deletes a whole hand-parallel file), shell-nav's five one-consumer transition functions fold into ShellStore (deletes 5 exports), and graph-wiring loses its two pure pass-through wrappers canConnect/canReconnect while gaining the one WireEnds type that makes the deliberate reverse-drag legible (net -1 export). The single additive step is resilience-hole-0007, cut to its minimum honest form: writeStored* returns a boolean instead of a three-reason discriminated union nobody consumes, and saved() is gated on it. Net effect: TriggerLab public surface 339 → ~264 members, 10 exported symbols deleted for 3 added, zero new architecture.

The store's public surface shrinks; nothing is added but one readonly accessor.

design.title: Collapse ShowLibrarySync + SongLibrarySync into one generic LibrarySync, delete both source files
design.intent: duplicated-code-0003: create apps/web/src/lib/trigger-lab/store/library-sync.ts exporting `LibrarySync<L, W>` parameterised by a codec `{ serialize(l: L): W; deserialize(raw: unknown): L | null }` and one generic `ReconcilePlan<L>` ({adopt|seed|noop} union). Method bodies (librarySig, markServerStateSeen, planReconcile, planFollow, noteSynced, planPush) move verbatim from show-library-sync.ts — they are already token-identical to song-library-sync.ts modulo the codec name. Construct `new LibrarySync(showCodec)` / `new LibrarySync(songCodec)` at the existing call sites in shows-controller.svelte.ts (~574-595). DELETE show-library-sync.ts and song-library-sync.ts entirely; the hand-maintained 'kept parallel' invariant becomes structural. Wire format is untouched: the codecs are the existing serialize/deserialize functions, unchanged.
design.verification: Both old files deleted (git status shows 2 deletions, 1 addition, net-negative LOC); pnpm typecheck clean; store.server-library.test.ts, store.song-library.test.ts, persistence.songlibrary.test.ts green — these pin both reconcile policies (viewer-follow, once-per-session gate, local-wins seed, echo suppression, serverStateSeen push gate) branch by branch; pnpm gates green at commit.

design.title: Fold shell-nav transitions into ShellStore; shell-nav.ts keeps only types, VIEWS, parseSearch

Retarget shell-nav.test.ts to construct `new ShellStore(...)` and assert the same invariants, keeping coverage of view-switch-clears-selection. Deletes 5 exported functions; adds nothing. liveRouting/patchRouting relocation is deliberately NOT done here (see open_questions).
design.verification: rg -n "initialNav|setView|select\(|clearSelection|isSelected" apps/web/src/lib/app/shell-nav.ts returns nothing; pnpm typecheck clean; the retargeted test still asserts setView clears selection on view change and passes under the component test env; pnpm gates green at commit.

design.title: Delete canConnect/canReconnect pass-throughs; classify* take a named WireEnds
design.intent: data-clumps-0005, subtractively: canConnect and canReconnect are pure pass-throughs whose entire body is `classify*( ...4 slots... ) === null` — delete both exports. Add `export interface WireEnds { from: string; to: string; fromPort?: string; toPort?: string }` and change classifyConnection(graph, w: WireEnds) / classifyReconnect(graph, edgeId, w: WireEnds); the private sameSlot helper takes WireEnds too. Repoint the 7 uses in TriggerGraphView.svelte (call sites become `classifyConnection(g, { from: toId, to: from.nodeId, toPort }) === null` — the deliberate reverse-drag swap at :565/:573 becomes self-documenting named fields) and store.svelte.ts connect/reconnect (~2678-2726). Net exported symbols: -2 +1.
design.verification: rg -n "canConnect|canReconnect" apps/web/src returns nothing outside the test file history; graph-wiring.test.ts green with WireEnds-shaped calls, still pinning every WireRejection reason and precedence; pnpm ui-shot on the Trigger Graph view confirms invalid-drop styling and the reverse-drag path (the one behaviour a transposition would silently break); pnpm gates green at commit.

design.title: writeStored* return success boolean; gate saved() on it; add 'error' save state
design.intent: resilience-hole-0007, minimum honest form. writeStoredLibrary/writeStoredSongLibrary (shows-controller.svelte.ts ~88-106) change return type void -> boolean (try { setItem; return true } catch { return false } / false when localStorage undefined) — still never throwing into the render loop. scheduleSave (store.svelte.ts ~1288-1309) calls saveStatusCtl.saved() only when the local writes returned true OR the server sync path actually ran (this.link === 'open'); otherwise it drives a new failed() transition. SaveStatus union (save-status.ts) gains 'error'; SaveStatusController gets the failed() event (terminal until next saving()); TopBar indicator renders the error state with a tooltip naming local-storage failure. NO three-reason discriminated union, no monitor event, no export affordance — those are speculative until a consumer exists (open question for Trent). The beforeunload/stopAutosave flushes keep their fire-and-forget shape (no UI can react there); only the indicator honesty changes. This is the plan's one deliberate addition (~40 LOC) and it closes the silent-data-loss path.
design.verification: New unit test: stub localStorage.setItem to throw QuotaExceededError with link !== 'open', drive an edit past the save debounce, assert the indicator lands on 'error' not 'saved' and no exception escapes the $effect; save-status.test.ts extended for failed(); existing happy-path autosave tests green unchanged; pnpm gates green at commit.

removed: 75 one-line forwarder members (showsCtl 35, sectionsCtl 18, monitor 12, midi 7, controllerTest 3 — per middle-man-0001 census)
interface_deltas.note: 339 -> ~264 public members. The controllers already exist; this publishes them instead of mirroring them.
Each Host has exactly one implementation (the inline literal in store.svelte.ts) and zero external importers — un-exported, not relocated.
Two files deleted, one created; the 'kept parallel by hand' comment-enforced invariant becomes structural.
Module keeps View/Selection/PatchNodeId/ShellNav types, VIEWS, parseSearch — the pieces with >1 consumer.
The two wrappers were pure `classify* === null` pass-throughs; WireEnds is the one addition data-clumps-0005 pays for with 8 call sites of positional-tuple deletion.
The plan's single deliberate addition: closes resilience-hole-0007's lying 'Saved' indicator. Cut to one bit + one state; the finding's three-reason union and export affordance are deferred to Trent.

behaviour_parity_evidence_plan.known_gaps: Green suite cannot prove parity where coverage is zero or reactivity is structural: (1) Svelte 5 rune reactivity through the new `store.shows.*` access path — getters returning a controller whose fields are $state is the same proxy graph, but no test asserts fine-grained re-render behaviour; replacement evidence is ui-shot captures plus the live smoke, which exercise real reactive subscriptions. (2) MIDI-learn and controller-monitor UI flows have little to no test coverage; replacement evidence is ui-shot of those panels plus manual arm/learn in the live smoke (S3 verification). (3) The beforeunload flush path is untestable in vitest and keeps fire-and-forget semantics deliberately — evidence is code-read only, and S9 does not change its behaviour. (4) The QuotaExceededError path had zero coverage at baseline; S9 ADDS the first test, so parity there is 'new behaviour by design', not preserved behaviour. (5) library-sync wire-format parity is proven by the untouched serializer functions plus the persistence.songlibrary.test.ts round-trips, not by the suite alone.
behaviour_parity_evidence_plan.baseline_reference: Phase 0 baseline: sha 3708648, 2968 tests green via pnpm gates, on top of tonight's landed fix batches 1-3 (dead-code auto-fixes, residue, kit-mirror removal).

rollback_strategy: Each wave lands as exactly one commit on a feature branch, in sequencing order; the initiative reverts as a contiguous `git revert` range in reverse wave order, and any single wave reverts independently except S5 (which depends on nothing after it) — later waves touch disjoint files from earlier ones by construction. No persisted-data migrations anywhere: library-sync (S6) keeps the exact wire/localStorage format because the codecs are the unchanged existing serializers; S9's 'error' SaveStatus is additive UI state with no persistence. If a controller-publishing step (S1-S5) breaks a surface discovered late, the cheap forward-fix is re-adding the specific forwarder as a temporary deprecated alias in a one-line commit — but the census check exists precisely to keep that from silently becoming permanent.

open_questions.question: Confirm direction (a) — publish the controllers and kill the forwarders — over direction (b) — revert the R20-R24 extraction and inline ~1,300 controller LOC back into store.svelte.ts. This plan commits to (a) because (b) deletes the seams AND regrows the god file toward ~5,000 lines, directly worsening divergent-change-0002; but making 5 controllers part of the permanent public store API is an architecture call.

divergent-change-0002's proposed three-facade split (authoring-document / library / device-link stores) is deliberately NOT in this plan — its own interface delta is 'increases', and forwarder deletion already moves four of the measured change axes out of store.svelte.ts. Should churn be re-measured ~20 commits after landing, with the facade split raised as a NEW initiative only if store.svelte.ts still dominates?

S9 ships only the honest 'error' indicator + tooltip. resilience-hole-0007's proposed 'Saving failed — export your show' affordance for the both-failed (offline + quota) case is a product-taste addition: want it, and if so in this initiative or as a follow-up?

speculative-generality-0007 also flags liveRouting/patchRouting as non-navigation state squatting on ShellStore. Moving it needs a destination decision (TriggerLab? a Patch-view-local store?), which is a domain-model call — S7 leaves it in place. Where should Patch routing state live?

Naming of the published seams: this plan uses store.shows / store.sections / store.monitor / store.controllerTest / store.midi (matching middle-man-0001's proposal, with 'monitor' over 'controller' to avoid colliding with controller-test). Implementer may adjust only if a name collides with an existing TriggerLab member.
